dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly concave spline following the trailing edge from the apex down to the posterior dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 55-degree posterior slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Uniformly convex arc describing the frontal-dorsal boundary of the cranial region.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope terminates and the rostrum begins.
